desc: Implement full solution: sliding-median window costs (two heaps + lazy deletion) plus O(nk) DP with prefix minima; 64-bit-safe INF.
Verify median-cost formula and DP correctness on the two given examples (got 8 and 3).

Brute-force cross-check on small random arrays (4012 tests passed: directed edge cases + 4000 randomized, covering negatives, duplicates, even/odd x, tight n==k*x packing; "at least k ≡ exactly k" verified empirically).

Build edge/performance harness with two independent references (sort-based median + exact-t DP over all t>=k; exhaustive subset enumeration) covering k=15, tight k*x==n packings, and ten n=1e5 max-size cases.
Execute the harness and confirm exit code 0: all correctness checks pass and all max-size performance cases finish within the time ceiling.
